{"consolidated_memory":"AUTHENTICATION TOKEN REFRESH 401 STORMS — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Component: services/auth/token_refresh.py (Python)
Test coverage: tests/auth/test_token_refresh.py
Problem manifestation (both): 401 storm in the refresh path — burst of unauthorized responses in the access log when an access token expires mid-session.

**INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-29]**
- Trigger: Access token expiration mid-session
- Environment: Staging read replica only
- Root cause: Cache entry never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the cache entry inside the write transaction (PR #3464, branch fix/401-storm-1)
- Measured outcome: Backlog cleared 62 minutes after deploy

**INCIDENT 2 [2026-06-01]**
- Trigger: Access token expiration mid-session, surfaced after rolling restart of fleet
- Environment: Post-rolling restart
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: Capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #6534, branch fix/401-storm-2)
- Measured outcome: Cold start dropped 84 percent to 90 ms

These represent distinct bugs in the same token refresh path, discovered and fixed in sequence over a 2-month span."}
